references.context: Collect the lit Gobstopper Jackpot at the Most Secret Machine.
references.label: Most Secret Machine
references.description: The center-left target and lock hole qualify Gobstopper locks, jackpots, and the four-ticket wizard mode.

references.context: Start a Factory Tour feature at the TV saucer.
references.label: TV saucer
references.description: The upper-right saucer starts Factory Tour modes, Computer Awards, and Pure Imagination.

references.context: Shoot the center ramp for a Double Jackpot.
references.label: Camera ramp
references.description: The upper-flipper ramp scores three Wonka Bars and Double Jackpots in the main multiballs.

references.context: Shoot the factory target when add-a-ball is lit.
references.label: Factory target
references.description: The standup near the left inlane adds mode time, completes a WONKA hurry-up, and can add a ball during Gobstopper Multiball.
